fields.description: Issue features a major investigative article alleging that psychiatrist Dr. T. Earl Moore (dubbed the “Torture Doctor”) caused or covered up the death of 17-year-old Mary Jane Korn, presenting purported documentary evidence and discrepancies from police/coroner accounts and correspondence connected to the 1944 death in a Moore cottage near his Tamiami Trail office. Additional content includes commentary on gambling policy and Florida Governor Fuller Warren, a reader letter about Miami Beach rent increases after decontrol, local employment/business statistics, and other local news and advertisements.
